The performance of healthcare departments and regions in Denmark regarding the diagnosis and treatment of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is systematically tracked through specific clinical indicators managed by the [[dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme|Dansk Kvalitetsdatabase for Inflammatoriske Tarmsygdomme]]. Overall, national performance shows mixed results depending on the specific metric, patient demographic, and required diagnostic procedures.

For adult patients, national targets for colonoscopies are generally being met. According to the 2023 report, 85% of patients nationwide underwent a colonoscopy within 18 months, fulfilling the minimum target of 80% [^src1]. Furthermore, the developmental goal for [[indikator-1a|Indikator 1a]] was achieved nationally, with 79% of 2,385 newly diagnosed patients receiving a colonoscopy [^src2]. However, regional and departmental variations persist. In 2023, four out of five regions met the target, with [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] falling short at 70% [^src1]. At the departmental level, 14 out of 21 departments met the 2023 objectives [^src1]. By 2024, regional variation for Indikator 1a in Region Sjælland ranged from 76% to 86% [^src2], and four specific departments — [[hvidovre|Hvidovre]], [[ouh-svendborg|OUH Svendborg]], [[aarhus-universitetshospital|Aarhus Universitetshospital]], and [[regionshospitalet-goedstrup|Regionshospitalet Gødstrup]] — reported fulfillment rates below 70% for Indikator 1a [^src2].

Performance regarding pediatric and adolescent patients, tracked under [[indikator-1b|Indikator 1b]], reveals significant shortcomings. Only 69% of newly diagnosed children and young people received a complete workup, missing the developmental goal of ≥80% [^src2]. Regionally, [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] achieved only a 38% fulfillment rate for Indikator 1b [^src2], and 8 out of 14 departments failed to meet the developmental goal [^src2]. A major bottleneck in completing these workups on time is specialized imaging; among the 65 newly diagnosed pediatric patients who did not meet the complete workup target, 60% were missing an [[mr-scanning-af-tyndtarm|MR-scanning of the small intestine]] or capsule endoscopy [^src2].

Additionally, performance assessments regarding bone density scanning show widespread systemic deficits. All regions and departments fall far short of the developmental goal for [[dexa-scanning|DEXA-scanning]], with the highest regional proportion at just 41% and the highest departmental level at 58% [^src3]. Ultimately, while adult colonoscopy indicators show general compliance with baseline targets, specialized indicators like pediatric complete workups and DEXA scans highlight critical areas where the Danish IBD healthcare system is underperforming.

## Claims

- På landsplan har 85 % af patienterne fået foretaget en koloskopi inden for 18 måneder, hvoraf målsætningen på mindst 80 % er opfyldt [^src1] (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- Udviklingsmålet for indikator 1a er nået på landsplan, da 79 % af de i alt 2385 nydiagnosticerede har fået foretaget koloskopi [^src1] (indikator-1a, dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- Regional variation for indikator 1a ligger fra 76 % til 86 % i Region Sjælland [^src1] (indikator-1a, region-sjaelland)
- Fire afdelinger — Hvidovre, OUH Svendborg, Aarhus og Gødstrup — har under 70 % opfyldelse af indikator 1a [^src1] (indikator-1a, hvidovre, ouh-svendborg, aarhus-universitetshospital, regionshospitalet-goedstrup)
- I alt 69 % af de nydiagnosticerede børn og unge har fået foretaget en komplet udredning for indikator 1b, hvormed udviklingsmålet på ≥80 % ikke er nået [^src1] (indikator-1b, dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- Region Nordjylland har kun 38 % opfyldelse af indikator 1b [^src1] (indikator-1b, region-nordjylland)
- 8 ud af 14 afdelinger lever ikke op til udviklingsmålet for indikator 1b [^src1] (indikator-1b, dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- Af de 65 nydiagnosticerede børn og unge, der ikke opfylder målet om komplet udredning til tiden, mangler 60 % MR-scanning/kapselendoskopi [^src1] (indikator-1b, mr-scanning-af-tyndtarm)
- På afdelingsniveau lever 14 ud af 21 afdelinger op til målsætningen [^src1] (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- Fire ud af fem regioner lever op til målsætningen, idet Region Sjælland med 70 % ikke lever op til målsætningen [^src1] (dansk-kvalitetsdatabase-for-inflammatoriske-tarmsygdomme)
- Alle regioner og afdelinger ligger langt fra udviklingsmålet, da regionen med højst andel DEXA-scanninger er på 41 % og afdelingsniveau på 58 % [^src1] (dexa-scanning)
